entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I hope you can help. I need to return something, and I'm just so confused by the website and the policies.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's a helmet I bought for my husband. It's just... the wrong color. It looked different online, and he won't wear it. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety equipment. Let me just pull up your order. Do you have the order number handy?
Um, yes, I think it's VF88602. Is that right? I get so overwhelmed with these things. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help. Let me see... Yes, I've found it. The VeloFit Aero helmet, delivered 25 days ago. One moment while I review the return eligibility for this item.
Oh no, is 25 days too long? I saw something about 20 days and got worried.

No reason to worry at all. Our policy for standard items like this helmet allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, as long as it's in its original condition. Since you mentioned the box is unopened, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? Ninety days? That's such a relief! I completely misunderstood. So I can send it back?
Absolutely. I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just attach that to the box and drop it off.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so simple. I was so stressed about it.
It's my pleasure. We want to make sure you're happy with your purchase, and getting the right color is part of that. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
